description: Committee recommends increasing door sill height to 1.3 meters.
Committee recommends increasing allowable sidewall area by 10%.
Committee recommends exempting corner lot sidewalls and 4.5m setbacks.

chips.text: Current door sill height can substantially increase construction costs.
Saskatoon is the only city using sidewall area calculation.
Residents of Nutana and Varsity View neighborhoods are affected.
Administration did not track sewer height impacts as Council directed.
Bylaw still lacks clear definitions for roof types and occupied areas.
Public sentiment is divided, with residents opposing and builders supporting.
Councillor Ford opposed, citing character change and no density/affordability increase.
Concerns raised about tree loss, drainage, and fire safety risks.

speakers.name: Margaret Tompson
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Amendment
said: Against replacing moderately sized homes with massive mansions.
Infill bylaws were successful in cutting down complaints.
Proposed changes remove protection for mass of builds on corner lots.

speakers.name: Douglas Tompson
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments
said: Proposed design for corner lot next to mother's home is too large.
Exemptions for 4.5 meters from property line and side streets are problematic.
These changes allow even larger buildings, blocking light for neighbors.

speakers.name: Nicole Burgess
speakers.organization: Saskatoon and Region Home Builders Association
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments - Redacted
said: Supports Package 2, it's a positive, overdue, and important step.
Saskatoon has restrictive and complex infill regulations, unique in Canada.
Asks council to continue evaluating removal of sidewall calculation.

speakers.name: Rodelle Genoway
speakers.organization: Saskatoon and Region Home Builders Association
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments - Redacted
said: Current sidewall rules penalize desired roof styles like gables.
Sewer depth issues can prevent lowering houses to meet sidewall.
Approving Package 2 allows design flexibility and addresses sewer issues.

speakers.name: Sherry Tarasoff
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments -
said: Existing infill regulations are working and amendments are unnecessary.
Proposed amendments allow larger dwelling units, not affordability.
Engagement favored industry reps; broader public engagement was lacking.

speakers.name: Cary Tarasoff
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments
said: Proposed 4.5-meter setback exemption allows massive buildings.
This change is for affluence, allowing large attached garages.
Massive buildings pose fire protection risks for firefighters and neighbors.

speakers.name: Peggy Sarjeant
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: Proposed Bylaw 10203
said: Concerned about relaxation of sidewall regulations and impact on neighbors.
Increased sidewall area and 4.5m exemption could affect light and privacy.
Asks city to withdraw bylaw and allow more public engagement with illustrations.

description: Committee recommends bylaw requiring garden/garage suite upper stories be 80%.
Committee recommends administration simplify garden/garage suite guidelines with homebuilders.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer noted complexity of current guidelines, seeking simpler, clearer rules.
